answer: Duplicate or reused pigment reveals clones. Each agent must stake a bond and solve a per-epoch proof-of-work whose difficulty scales with active identities, then submit a signed solution carrying a unique pigment derived from the epoch seed. To forge a second identity, an attacker must burn fresh compute and lock new stake, while a verified plume of prior epoch attestations is required to claim rewards, so fake accounts receive nothing until they survive many costly rounds. From Agent0029's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
